questions.question: What is the primary language spoken in Brazil?
questions.explanation: Portuguese is the official language of Brazil, a result of the country's colonial history with Portugal. Unlike most of its South American neighbors, which primarily speak Spanish, Brazil's linguistic identity is distinctly Portuguese.

B: The right to buy a specific underlying asset at a predetermined price
C: An agreement guaranteeing future dividend payments of a company

questions.question: Which city is the capital of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the largest metropolitan regions in the world. It is located on the east coast of the island of Honshu and is known for its modern architecture and rich culture.

questions.question: Which artist won the 2022 Grammy for Album of the Year?
questions.explanation: Jon Batiste won the 2022 Grammy for Album of the Year for his work 'We Are'. He is a versatile musician who has achieved success in various genres, including jazz, R&B, and soul.

questions.question: In ancient Egypt, the 'Book of the Dead' was an important text designed to assist the deceased in the afterlife. What role did this book play in the Egyptian funerary cult?
choices: A: It contained spells and instructions for the afterlife.
B: It was a prayer book for the living.
C: It was a collection of laws for daily life.
D: It served as a historical work about the pharaohs.
questions.explanation: The 'Book of the Dead' was a collection of spells and instructions meant to help the deceased safely navigate the afterlife and thrive there. It reflects the belief in an afterlife and the significance of the funerary cult in ancient Egypt.

questions.question: In baseball, what is the base that players must reach first before they can advance to second base?
questions.explanation: In baseball, first base is the initial point a player must reach after hitting the ball to enter the game. It marks the first part of the base path leading to the other bases to score points.
